title: mmdflux snapshot diff (mmdflux.diff.v1)
description: Versioned JSON view of a snapshot diff between two MMDS documents. Within v1, new kinds, categories and fields are additive; consumers must ignore what they do not recognize.

summary.description: Number of included changes in each category.

GeometryLevel.description: MMDS geometry level of a compared document. Known values: layout, routed.

id.description: Index of the change in the full diff. Stable when a layer filter drops other changes.

kind.description: Stable change kind name, for example NodeAdded, EdgeReconnected or LabelMoved. New kinds are additive.

category.description: Coarse grouping. Known values: added, removed, changed, moved.

layer.description: Known values: model (what the diagram says) and geometry (where it is drawn).

before.description: The subject's describing values in the before document, when it exists there.

after.description: The subject's describing values in the after document, when it exists there.

related.description: Ids of included changes related to this one, such as geometry effects of a model change.

evidence.description: Diagnostic strings, present only when requested. Not format-stable.

type.description: Known values: document, node, edge, subgraph.

before_id.description: Edge id in the before document; null when the edge was added.

after_id.description: Edge id in the after document; null when the edge was removed.

extension_namespace.description: For ExtensionChanged, the extension namespace that changed.
